name: emirastic-ict-quiz
description: Emirastic ICT Quiz - Full-stack quiz application for ICT-Fachmann EFZ apprenticeship

scripts.start: node start-mongodb.js && concurrently "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.dev: node start-mongodb.js && concurrently "npm run backend-dev" "npm run frontend"
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
